old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-ffnz","title":"Make trust-store persistence durable, private, and concurrency-safe","description":"SECURITY/ROBUSTNESS: TrustStorePersistence.save writes a predictable shared .tmp without locking or O_EXCL, does not set the directory/file to 0700/0600, and renames without fsyncing the directory.
